newsitem.title: USA: Marquette, Diametrics in marketing deal.
newsitem.headline: Marquette, Diametrics in marketing deal.

text.p: Marquette Medical Systems Inc and Diametrics Medical Inc entered into a co-marketing agreement allowing Marquette's 200 U.S. field sales representatives to sell Diametrics' IRMA SL portable bedside blood analyzer, the companies said.
The agreement also calls for Diametrics sales persons to involve Marquette sales representatives in any additional opportunities for patient monitoring business.
The agreement stems from a previous collaboration between the firms to develop an interface between the IRMA SL analyzer and Marquette's Unity Network, they said.
That project was recently completed and is now commercially available as a network link that automatically displays bedside blood test results on the vital signs monitor, the companies said.
Marquette Medical, based here, makes medical electronics equipment and other products. Diametrics, of St. Paul, Minn., makes blood analysis system.
